title: Juicy Herbal Syrian Lamb Burger
description: A flavorful Syrian dish featuring lamb burgers seasoned with herbs and spices, served on sesame seed buns, cooked in a copper pot with tadka for added flavor, this halal friendly meal is sure to impress
instructions: Preheat the copper pot over medium heat and add tadka oil for cooking
Add the chopped onion to the copper pot and cook until it is translucent
Add the ground cumin and coriander to the copper pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the ground lamb to the copper pot, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks
Season the lamb with salt and black pepper to taste
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Form the lamb mixture into 4 patties and cook for 4 minutes per side
Toast the sesame seed buns in the copper pot for 1 minute
Assemble the burgers with the cooked lamb patties, lemon juice, and any desired toppings
Serve the burgers immediately and enjoy
